method: split-half reliability within role, per level: each competition's full double round robin regenerated 6 times with measurement seeds (regista.catalogue.measure), each season cut into its first and second half of rounds, each half computed with the catalogue engine's rule for its competition; values centred on the role's mean in that competition-season; rows pooled over the level's competitions and seasons. r is the split-half correlation, season_r its Spearman-Brown estimate for a whole season, 2r/(1+r). noisy: r below 0.3
note: measured per level on full regenerated seasons of its competitions (split in halves of rounds); the uploaded sample of every sparse competition is smaller than half a season, so its numbers are noisier still
